The Department of Veterans Affairs, Veterans Health Administration, Network Contracting Office 06 (NCO 6), intends to solicit quotes from contractors for: Domiciliary Furniture for the Behavioral Health Unit at the Hampton VA Medical Center located at:
 
Â 
Hampton VA Medical Center
Bldg 148
100 Emancipation Drive
Hampton, VA 23667
 
Â 
The VAMC anticipates posting a Small Business Set-Aside RFQ for this requirement to SAM.gov on or about: March 30, 2026. Interested contractors will be responsible for downloading copies of the solicitation (and any subsequent amendments) from SAM.gov, and no hard copies will be made available.  The solicitation will provide instructions to offerors about the quote submission process.  Prospective offerors are encouraged to register their interest in the solicitation on the SAM.gov website  (https://www.sam.gov) so that they are notified of the issuance of the solicitation and any amendments.
Â 
NAICS Code: 337127 Institutional Furniture Manufacturing 
Â 
Classification Code: 6530 - Hospital Furniture, Equipment, Utensils, and Supplies 

Small Business Size Standard: 500 employees.

Proposed Solicitation Number: 36C24626Q0439
Â 
Anticipated Closing Response Date: April 16, 2026
Â 
Period of Performance: Base Only
 
Â 
Description: 
Â 
Domiciliary Furniture for the Hampton VA Medical Center Behavioral Health Unit. Contractor shall provide all labor, material, equipment, delivery and installation. All responsible sources may submit quotes which shall be considered by the Agency. 
Â 
Questions concerning this announcement should be directed to the Contract Officer using the email address below.  Telephone requests for information or questions will NOT be accepted.  
Please email requests to Ruth Morris at the following e-mail address: ruth.morris@va.gov and ensure that the subject line includes Solicitation No. 36C24626Q0439.
